body:
Unable to score any acid, I decided to see what LSD's sister drug, LSA, could do for me.  So I went to my local
garden store and got ten packs of Heavenly Blue Morning Glory seeds.  They're pretty cheap (especially if you don't pay for them  :)  ).  When I got home at about 7:00 pm, I ate two packs of seeds.  I didn't have any alcohol to do the extraction, so I just chewed the damn things and swallowed 'em.  The first pack was easy to swallow, but the second almost made me gag. I got all 3 grams of seeds down, though.
I had an empty stomach, which was probably why at about 7:30, I started feeling really nauseous.  I took a few
antacids to help.  Around 8:00, the effects kicked in while the nausea was slowly declining.  As I sat on my couch, my vision started to 'shift.'  I would describe it as being like a camera zooming in and out while twisting slightly (it was quite interesting).  I decided to listen to some music, and was I glad I did.  Music sounded incredible; all I could do was zone out in awe.
Around 8:30, the nausea was doing much better, but my leg muscles started to hurt like hell whenever I stood up and walked.  This really sucked, but it, like the nausea, got better.
At 10:00, I was still feeling weird.  Whenever I looked at something, it seemed 'different.'  I couldn't put my finger on it. That's all I can describe it as.  Anyway, I finally went to bed around 11:00.  This was the best part of the trip; this is where the effects were most pronounced.  I listened to some more music as I tried to sleep.  I say 'tried' because I was having too much fun with all of the closed-eye visuals I was having.  Whenever I shut my eyes, I could see intricate geometric patterns like rippling checkerboards.  I also saw some other weird images like some serpents crawling all over each other, but it wasn't scary at all.  It was all made even better by the music. The music was penetrating deep into my mind, almost like it was cleansing me.
It was all made even better by the music. The music was penetrating deep into my mind, almost like it was cleansing me.
Again, difficult to describe, but very wonderful.
The next day, I felt very mellow and relaxed.  This pleasant feeling lasted until later that night.  This was my first time with Morning Glory seeds, and it won't be my last.
